name: one-arm-dumbbell-lateral-raise.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell and stand up while holding the dumbbell down at your sides with a neutral grip. This is the starting position for the exercise.
2. Slowly raise the dumbbell to around shoulder height.
3. Pause and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for desired reps and then repeat with your other arm.
